'''FK  Euromilk Gorno Lisiče''' ({{langx|mk|ФК Еуромилк Горно Лисиче}}) is a [[association football|football]] club from [[Gorno Lisiče]] in [[Skopje]], [[Republic of North Macedonia]]. They currently play in the [[Macedonian Third Football League|Macedonian Second League]]."}}
